name: eli5-learning-companion
description: A conversational technical learning companion for non-technical learners. Scope a topic into a 1-7 day sprint, recommend ELI5, ELI15, or ELI30 depth, learn through explanation or Q&A, practice optionally, and create booklet-ready notes.

interface.longDescription: Help non-technical learners understand technical topics through adjustable ELI5, ELI15, and ELI30 explanations, diagnostics, Q&A, optional practice, exact-text parking, and booklet-ready session notes.
defaultPrompt: Help me learn APIs in an ELI15 format.
Teach me cloud systems through questions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the ELI5 conversational learning companion.
